purpose: Replace the simulator-generated visibility mask in V2-M4 with agent-side geometric visibility inference from sensed occupancy only

amendment_record.reason: Under protocol v2 the best formal mechanism (discrete motion-hypothesis filter with online pause learning, suspend/re-anchor, and a reachable-interval floor) reached 0.5461 moving-hidden probability against the 0.55 minimum while the assume_all_visible control rose to 0.5760 against its 0.55 maximum. Instrumentation showed the structural cause: reachable-interval support is visibility-agnostic, so it carries the control almost as much as the formal agent, and the only surface where visibility inference matters - in-window occluded samples - is roughly 15 percent of all hidden samples, forcing both gates onto the same knife edge. V3 therefore enlarges that discriminating surface: the pause columns move from three cells beside the screen to one cell on each side (the deepest shadow from an opposite-side camera), and the bounce walls tighten from columns 2/22 to 6/18 so the object spends more hidden time inside the window's reach. No formal threshold, seed, agent constraint, or control criterion changes.

environment.objects: diagnostic V2-M4 layout plus two seed-jittered static blocks inside the central screen's habitual shadow bands
environment.moving_object_pause: the moving object pauses for 10 steps at one cell to either side of the screen column - the deepest shadow cells from an opposite-side camera - once per crossing direction
environment.moving_object_range: bounce walls at columns 6 and 18 keep the object within the camera's habitual window reach
environment.occlusion_model: discrete line-of-sight: a cell in the local window is hidden when any strictly intermediate cell on the Bresenham ray from the camera cell is truly occupied
environment.agent_observation: an 11x11 patch of visibly occupied cells only (occluded cells are indistinguishable from free cells); the executed action copy; no visibility channel, no labels
environment.evaluation_only: true occupancy grid and true visibility, used exclusively to score hidden-cell metrics after the fact

formal_agent.mechanism: deterministic geometric shadow-casting over the sensed patch reconstructs a visibility estimate; the log-odds occupancy update and moving-entity tracking then consume only sensed occupancy plus that self-inferred estimate
constraints: update() accepts sensed occupancy and the action copy only; a visibility parameter must not exist in its signature
no simulator internals, labels, masks, or counterfactual branches may be read by the agent

required_mechanism_controls.random_action: active=False variant used for the step-reduction gate
required_mechanism_controls.assume_all_visible: identical agent with shadow-casting disabled; it must fail the moving-hidden-probability gate, because treating occluded cells as visibly empty erases the paused hidden object

decision_rule: Development passing every fixed gate authorizes exactly one holdout run. A passing holdout authorizes reconnection design review toward the original object-permanence M2. A failing holdout cannot be repaired by rerunning holdout seeds or editing this protocol; a new mechanism requires a new preregistration.
thresholds_note: All formal thresholds equal the diagnostic V2-M4 gates so the only change under test is removing the privileged visibility mask; v3 changed only the occlusion-stress geometry of the environment.
